documents.name: checkpoint-resume-workflow
documents.text: Kill a workflow mid-run at a stage boundary. Persist a checkpoint of completed stages. Resume the same inputs from that checkpoint without replaying prior side effects. Refuse a corrupted checkpoint rather than a partial run.

documents.name: checkpoint-resume-pipeline
documents.text: Kill a workflow mid-run at a stage boundary. Persist a checkpoint of completed stages. Resume the same inputs from that checkpoint without replaying prior side effects. Refuse a corrupted checkpoint rather than a partial run.

documents.name: checkpoint-resume-workflow-retries
documents.text: Kill a workflow mid-run at a stage boundary. Persist a checkpoint of completed stages. Resume the same inputs from that checkpoint without replaying prior side effects. Refuse a corrupted checkpoint after three retries rather than a partial run.

documents.name: checkpoint-resume-workflow
documents.text: Kill a workflow mid-run at a stage boundary; persist a checkpoint of completed stages. Resume the same inputs from that checkpoint without replaying prior side effects. Refuse a corrupted checkpoint rather than a partial run.

documents.name: abort-snapshot-continue
documents.text: Abort the job halfway through a step edge. Snapshot done stages into durable store. Continue the identical inputs off stored progress and skip already-applied mutations. Reject a damaged savepoint instead of emitting a half result.

documents.name: four-voice-council
documents.text: Four named voices propose and dissent. Unanimous agreement or recorded dissent. Quorum of four. Cap at eight rounds. Timeout ends the session. Prompt sections only. No compiled policy tree.

documents.name: tracer-prediction
documents.text: Predict the action list a live execution would perform. Compare predicted writes against a filesystem tracer. Flag any destructive write present in the live execution and absent from the prediction.

documents.name: license-census
documents.text: Walk every source file and record its SPDX license identifier. Hold the merge when a file has no license or an unknown identifier. Never infer a license from neighboring files.
